risk_note: F1-15b (orchestrator 2026-11-10, after backend B2-16d #3141; planning/01 F-ADM-27). Admin, read only, permission fund.view: a config-center subpage /invite-rewards lists invite reward records (filters invitee / inviter / status / qualified dates, page / page_size; masked phones as given; per-party results and skip / void reasons labelled per party, enum names in Chinese; amount fen shown as yuan; granted_at in its own column with a placeholder when null) with a detail drawer (adminGetInviteReward, 30701 empty state). The config center's invite group shows the budget used and remaining (today: daily_budget_fen minus today.granted_fen; total: total_budget_fen minus reserved minus granted; negative shown as 0.00; limits from the config rows), money only through parseFen / subFen / formatYuanAdmin. No new sidebar menu (the frozen admin-shell menu list is unchanged): the page is a config-center subpage like exports under audit logs. Without fund.view neither the budget block nor the entry shows and the subpage shows no permission. No write operation. Rule tests by an independent Claude in two rounds (r1 had 32 TS2345 on nullable masked phones; r2 fixed them and pinned per-party results and granted_at, closing Codex spec-test r1's two out-of-scope notes); Codex spec-test r1 pass, r2 pass; red on couli-ci (25 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5: couli-ci browser green; the couli-ci fast run stopped at the unrelated tools/ci/contracts-artifact.test.ts CT-05a#13 (test machine container has no git repository, reported), so the six related admin rule-test directories were run on the host: 21 files, 214 tests passed; run.ts static 10/10. The review tool classifies the task as RV2: Codex money review r1 pass, no findings. Written by hand.
